clues: This company was founded in January 2022 and is headquartered in Huntington Beach, California.
Its early demonstration missions included the Brokkr-1 CubeSat and the Odin probe on a lunar flight.
Ground communications and support account for nearly one-third of this company's total mission costs.
It created Solo, an onboard software layer designed to analyze raw telemetry and take autonomous corrective actions.
Its long-term commercial goal is to harvest platinum and other valuable minerals from deep-space asteroids.
